newsitem.title: USA: Paramount to resume production of "Frasier".
newsitem.headline: Paramount to resume production of "Frasier".

text.p: Production of the "Frasier" television sitcom, now on hold for the substance abuse treatment of its star, Kelsey Grammer, will resume in mid-October, Paramount Television said Wednesday.
It said Grammer will film his scenes when he returns to the set later in the month.
Grammer checked into the Betty Ford Centre, near Palm Springs, Calif., for substance abuse last week after he crashed his sports car outside of his Los Angeles home and was booked for drunk driving.
The 40 year-old actor was hospitalized for a head injury he sustained in the accident, but escaped serious injury.

Paramount said the air date schedule of the NBC sitcom was not impacted by Grammer's absence since a number of episodes have already beed produced and are awaiting broadcast following the baseball playoffs, which are currently preempting "Frasier."

Grammer, who plays a psychologist turned radio talk show host on the Emmy Award-winnong show, has a history of substance abuse problems and in the past has been convicted of drunken driving and cocaine possession.
